image_description: A wide-angle interior shot of a church sanctuary looking down the central aisle. The focal point is a raised altar structure at the far end, positioned beneath a large arched stained-glass window. The altar appears to be a stone or marble structure with a central tabernacle or reredos featuring gold detailing and religious iconography. It is flanked by large floral arrangements with red flowers and greenery. Wooden pews line both sides of the aisle in the foreground. The lighting is warm, emanating from wall sconces and the window.
